findings.title: Auth bypass jwt
findings.description: During security analysis of `http://example.com`, a Auth Bypass vulnerability was identified at endpoint `/api/v1/login`. The vulnerable input vector is the `auth` parameter.
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to the target endpoint `/api/v1/login` on host `http://example.com`.
Send a crafted HTTP request to `/api/v1/login`.
Observe the anomalous response behavior confirming auth bypass.
findings.impact: An attacker could bypass authentication mechanisms and impersonate arbitrary user accounts or administrative identities.
findings.remediation: Enforce strong authentication mechanisms, secure session management, and server-side token validation on all protected endpoints.

findings.title: Endpoint in /api/v1/login
findings.description: During security analysis of `example.com`, a Endpoint vulnerability was identified at endpoint `/api/v1/login`.
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to the target endpoint `/api/v1/login` on host `example.com`.
Send a crafted HTTP request to `/api/v1/login`.
Observe the anomalous response behavior confirming endpoint.
findings.impact: Successful exploitation could compromise the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of the application with info impact.
findings.remediation: Apply input validation, output encoding, and principle of least privilege to remediate the underlying flaw (CWE-699).
